remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Backing inscription 3 refers to whereabouts of O'Keeffe when work was painted. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1922. Backing inscription 1 dates 1923. description: Rolling green and blue hills spread out under a dark blue night sky with a pink moon at its center. Between the sky and hills is a thin strip of water that faintly reflects the moon.
